description: Land Acquisition - Puwakdandawa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose (railway line) and will be acquired. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels (extents, boundaries, lot numbers, and location details), which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land acquisition matters.
